recognize_zh: 周邊血液中一顆淋巴球胞質量中等且淡藍，含少數細小嗜天青顆粒，核偏位、染色質濃縮，這是大顆粒淋巴球（LGL）；若持續 >2×10⁹/L 或具克隆性，需考慮 T-LGL 白血病。
features: Lymphocyte slightly larger than a small lymphocyte
Moderate to abundant pale blue cytoplasm
Few fine azurophilic granules in the cytoplasm
Round to oval, slightly eccentric nucleus with condensed chromatin and no nucleoli
Background red cells without significant abnormality
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single large granular lymphocyte with a round-to-oval eccentric nucleus, condensed chromatin, and moderate pale blue cytoplasm containing a few fine azurophilic granules. The surrounding red cells show no significant morphologic abnormality. A single LGL is not diagnostic in itself; a sustained LGL count above 2 x 10^9/L with a clonal CD3+/CD8+/CD57+ population and STAT3 mutation would be consistent with T-cell large granular lymphocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Reactive LGLs look identical and are distinguished only by lack of clonality (TRG/TRB) and a transient course.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells
ddx.vs: NK-cell LGLs are CD3-negative (surface) and CD16+/CD56+, which requires flow cytometry rather than morphology.
Aggressive NK leukemia cells are larger with more open chromatin, nucleoli and basophilic cytoplasm, often EBV-positive.
Monocytes are larger with folded nuclei, lacy chromatin and grey-blue vacuolated cytoplasm with fine dusty granules.
